actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The LeCasa README describes the project as a Real2Sim2Real platform for joint-level teleoperation, dataset collection, Vision-Language-Action policy training and evaluation in both simulation and real robots
The README says the work focuses on single- and multi-stage tasks in RoboCasa kitchen environments using the SO101 arm, with policies trained through the LeRobot framework
main.py resolves the robot model from src/robot/so101_simplified.xml and passes it to the task controller as robot_xml_path
The model compiler declares angle='radian' and meshdir='assets' with autolimits='true', so its joint ranges are radians, its meshes resolve under src/robot/assets and a range implies the limit
The default joint class sets damping 0.60, frictionloss 0.052 and armature 0.028
The default geom class sets contype 0, conaffinity 0 and friction '2.0 0.8 0.3'
The base body is at the origin with quat '1 0 0 0'
shoulder_pan is a hinge joint with range -1.9198621771937616 to 1.9198621771937634 rad and damping 0.60
shoulder_lift is a hinge joint with range -1.7453292519943224 to 1.7453292519943366 rad and damping 0.60
elbow_flex is a hinge joint with range -1.69 to 1.69 rad and damping 0.60
wrist_flex is a hinge joint with range -1.6580628494556928 to 1.6580627293335335 rad and damping 0.60
wrist_roll is a hinge joint with range -2.7438472969992493 to 2.841206309382605 rad and damping 0.60
gripper is a hinge joint with range -0.17453297762778586 to 1.7453291995659765 rad and damping 0.60

The model has six position actuators named shoulder_pan, shoulder_lift, elbow_flex, wrist_flex, wrist_roll and gripper; each sets kp 17.8, forcerange -3.35 to 3.35 and a ctrlrange that rounds its joint range to five decimals
The model's equality section is empty

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed that selects a state (the reset input seed is accepted for the class contract, but the reset restores the model defaults), so a run repeats on the same engine and no seed selects a different state.  The fake stand-in is not MuJoCo and is not claimed to reproduce a MuJoCo trajectory.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the model file for the joint count, the actuator count and the control ranges but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts, actuator dynamics and the model's damping, frictionloss and armature are not MuJoCo's

no mesh or texture of src/robot/assets is loaded and no contact, equality or tendon constraint is resolved by the stand-in; the model's equality section is empty, and the stand-in does not use the collision geoms (contype/conaffinity 1) either
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine

the card's scene model configs/kitchen_configs/kitchen_robot_scene.xml is not served: its mesh and texture files are absolute Windows paths outside the clone, so the self-contained robot model is served; the kitchen objects and fixtures of that scene are not modelled
no rendering is offered and no physical SO101 robot is modelled; nothing was validated against the LeRobot or hardware stack

safe_state.description: an e-stop latches the runtime and no further step or reset reaches the model until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; time, qpos, qvel and ctrl remain readable and unchanged
